movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms held in the air, bringing hands together medially to clap in the center.

signature_moves.description: Bringing hands together medially while in the circle to clap once or twice.
signature_moves.name: Central Clap

signature_moves.description: A complete rotation of the body performed in place.
signature_moves.name: Full Twist

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts slow and gradually increases in speed.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Variable; the musician tunes the beat to the technique of the performers.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is driven by the Dhol, a double-headed barrel drum, which provides a consistent beat that can be adjusted in real-time by the musician to match the dancers' movements.

basic_steps: Form a circle with other dancers.
Execute a full twist in place.
Bring hands together medially to clap once or twice in the center of the circle.
teaching.level_notes: The dance starts slow and gradually increases in tempo.
teaching.rhythm: The rhythm is dictated by the Dhol player, who adjusts the beat to the dancers' technique.
